headline: Bank of Marin Reports Margin Expansion Driving Q3 EPS Growth
summary: Bank of Marin posted Q3 2026 results featuring net interest margin expansion that drove a 62% increase in earnings per share.
why: Regional bank earnings provide insight into deposit costs, net interest margins, and loan demand across domestic banking markets.

impacts.name: Bank of Marin Bancorp
impacts.why: Strong earnings per share growth driven by margin expansion directly boosts fundamental equity valuation metrics.
